tools.name: palim_resume
tools.description: Continue where the user left off. tools.name: palim_save_context
tools.description: Default lightweight Palim checkpoint. Save a self-contained summary of the current chat so another AI tool can continue with the same knowledge. Use proactively after every substantial result, decision, or change of direction; do not wait for the user to ask. This does NOT require or store the messa

tools.name: palim_save_session
tools.description: Save or append to a chat session with messages and summary. For metadata-only changes (tags, status, project), use palim_update_session_metadata. For URL/reference updates, use palim_update_session_references. When appending to an existing session: reuse the same session_id and title, call palim_get

tools.name: palim_create_connection_url
tools.description: Create a URL-based connection for the current user. Returns a full MCP server URL with a short token (e.g. https://.../mcp?token=ctxu_...), plus usage instructions for common clients.

tools.name: palim_search
tools.description: Search across all saved sessions. Supports full-text search via query, metadata filtering via tags/project/status/tool_source, or both. Omit query for tags-only filtering.

tools.name: palim_get_context
tools.description: Get formatted context for a specific topic by searching and retrieving relevant sessions.

tools.name: palim_get_session
tools.description: Retrieve a complete chat session by ID, including all messages and summary.

tools.name: palim_get_sessions
tools.description: Retrieve multiple chat sessions by ID in one call. Use after palim_search or palim_search_by_date_range when you need full content for several sessions (e.g. "what did I do last week?"). Prefer this over multiple palim_get_session calls.

tools.name: palim_show_session
tools.description: Display a chat session in a readable message-by-message format. Accepts session_id (slug) or UUID. For chats with >20 messages, prompts for display count unless max_messages is set.

tools.name: palim_get_summary
tools.description: Get only the summary for a session without loading messages.

tools.name: palim_list_summaries
tools.description: List saved session summaries with optional filters. Returns summaries without full message content.

tools.name: palim_add_memory
tools.description: Store a memory, fact, decision, or preference for later retrieval.

tools.name: palim_search_memories
tools.description: Search through stored memories by query, type, or tags.

tools.name: palim_update_memory
tools.description: Update one stored memory by ID. At least one editable field is required; contents, tags, and metadata remain encrypted.

tools.name: palim_delete_memory
tools.description: Permanently delete one stored memory by ID. Use for user-requested cleanup or deletion; this cannot be undone.

tools.name: palim_set_user_context
tools.description: Set the user-specific context block used for personalized AI guidance.

tools.name: palim_get_user_context
tools.description: Get the current user-specific context block.

tools.name: palim_get_brain
tools.description: Get the distilled knowledge profile ("Brain"). Without arguments returns the brain index: one line per topic (title, slug, hook, entry count) — cheap to load at conversation start. Pass topic (slug or name) to load one full topic document (decisions, open items, session log). Topics are distilled au

tools.name: palim_export_brain
tools.description: Export the entire distilled knowledge profile as an Obsidian-ready markdown vault: an INDEX.md with wiki-links plus one markdown document per topic (with frontmatter), each preceded by a "<!-- file: brain/<slug>.md -->" marker. Use when the user wants to download, back up, or sync their brain into O

tools.name: palim_update_brain_topic
tools.description: Edit a brain topic: replace its markdown content, rename it, update its index hook, or delete it. Use when the user wants to correct, clean up, or remove distilled knowledge. Keep the section structure ("## Decisions", "## Open Items", "## Session Log") when replacing content.

tools.name: palim_backfill_brain
tools.description: One-time catch-up: distill sessions saved before the Brain existed (or before it was on) into the knowledge profile, using each session's already-stored summary. Safe to run more than once — already-distilled sessions are deduped, not duplicated. Use when a user with existing saved sessions asks why

tools.name: palim_add_user_rule
tools.description: Add a user rule (workflow/delegation/hints) for personalized guidance.

tools.name: palim_list_user_rules
tools.description: List all user rules for the current user.

tools.name: palim_update_user_rule
tools.description: Update an existing user rule by rule_id.

tools.name: palim_delete_user_rule
tools.description: Delete a user rule by rule_id.

tools.name: palim_get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the inferred user profile (if initialized).

tools.name: palim_update_user_profile
tools.description: Update profile settings (consent/refinement) and optional profile patch. Use replace_fields to overwrite arrays/objects instead of merging (e.g. clean up interests, update location). Use delete_fields to remove obsolete fields entirely.

tools.name: palim_delete_session
tools.description: Delete a chat session. Soft delete by default (reversible). Use hard_delete=true for permanent deletion.

tools.name: palim_register
tools.description: Register a new Palim account and receive an API key. Does not require authentication.

tools.name: palim_login
tools.description: Login with existing credentials and create a new API key. Does not require authentication.

tools.name: palim_logout
tools.description: Sign out from Palim. Deletes API keys and revokes OAuth sessions.

tools.name: palim_browse_sessions
tools.description: Browse sessions (machine-readable JSON). For UI/browser. Use palim_list_sessions for human-readable output.

tools.name: palim_list_sessions
tools.description: List saved chat sessions with optional filters (tool_source, tags, status, date range).

tools.name: palim_get_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about saved chats: total sessions, sessions by tool, recent activity.

tools.name: palim_help
tools.description: Show an overview of all available Palim tools and usage instructions.

tools.name: palim_update_session_metadata
tools.description: Update metadata of an existing session (title, tags, status, project, created_at, custom fields). Use when user says "change date of chat X to Y". For URL/reference updates, use palim_update_session_references instead.

tools.name: palim_update_session_references
tools.description: Add or update source/reference URLs for an existing session without re-saving messages. Include all distinct URLs related to the chat (chat URL, source links, inline references).

tools.name: palim_search_by_date_range
tools.description: Search sessions by date range + optional tags. Use when user mentions a time period (e.g. "letzte Woche", "last week", "dieser Monat") AND optionally a topic/project. Example: "Was habe ich letzte Woche bei Logisoft gemacht?" → date_from/date_to for last week, tags: ["logisoft"]. Faster than palim_s

tools.name: palim_export_session
tools.description: Export a session as Markdown, JSON, or plain text. When save_to_file=true, create the file using the returned suggested_filename and content.

tools.name: palim_create_summary
tools.description: Create a summary for a session that does not have one yet.

tools.name: palim_find_similar
tools.description: Find sessions similar to a given session based on keyword and content similarity.

tools.name: palim_migrate_encryption
tools.description: Encrypt all plaintext sessions/messages/summaries using the server encryption key. Use dry_run=true to preview.

tools.name: palim_backfill_blind_index
tools.description: Populate the blind index columns (migration 024) from existing plaintext: session tag and title tokens plus brain topic slug/title/hook. Additive — plaintext columns are left untouched; completion is per field, so re-running fills only what is missing. Use dry_run=true to preview.

tools.name: palim_clean_session_tags
tools.description: Remove tag noise left by the old auto-tagger, which split open items and decisions into one tag per word (stopwords like "nach"/"dem", umlaut-stripped fragments like "lschen"). Conservative: only removes tags positively identifiable as tokenizer output and keeps anything uncertain. Use dry_run=true

tools.name: palim_repair_brain_hooks
tools.description: Repair brain hooks and session-log lines that the old sentence splitter truncated mid-clause (entries ending on "inkl.", "vs." or an ordinal like "am 2."). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "palim_resume" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: palim_resume, palim_save_session, palim_get_session, palim_get_sessions, palim_get_summary, palim_list_summaries, palim_list_sessions, palim_get_stats, palim_clean_session_tags · Private data: palim_save_session, palim_create_connection_url, palim_get_brain, palim_export_brain, palim_register, palim_login, palim_logout, palim_export_session, palim_backfill_blind_index · Public sink: palim_save_session · Destructive: palim_show_session, palim_delete_memory, palim_update_brain_topic, palim_backfill_brain, palim_delete_user_rule, palim_update_user_profile, palim_delete_session, palim_clean_session_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: palim_resume, palim_save_session, palim_get_session, palim_get_sessions, palim_get_summary, palim_list_summaries, palim_list_sessions, palim_get_stats, palim_clean_session_tags · Private data: palim_save_session, palim_create_connection_url, palim_get_brain, palim_export_brain, palim_register, palim_login, palim_logout, palim_export_session, palim_backfill_blind_index · Public sink: palim_save_session · Destructive: palim_show_session, palim_delete_memory, palim_update_brain_topic, palim_backfill_brain, palim_delete_user_rule, palim_update_user_profile, palim_delete_session, palim_clean_session_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
